svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Brush Drive — White Navigation
svg.desc: The selected transparent-header Brush Drive website retains its untinted Ferrari photograph, white Futura CHASE THE headline, genuine red Brush Script feeling emphasis, editorial collection section and red footer. Only the transparent header changes: the wordmark beside the unchanged crest is white, and white icon-and-text navigation labels connect Discover, Collections, Journal, About and My Garage. The direct logo has no backing plate; the active Discover rule remains red.

g.text: FOR THE CARS THAT STAY WITH YOU

text.tspan: Make a place for your next dream.

g.text: RED EXTERIOR / TAN INTERIOR / SILVER WHEELS

text.tspan: Turn a passing obsession into a personal collection.
Keep the cars you love close.
See which one speaks to you.

g.text: A home for the cars you dream about.
